body.p: Claims 1-20 are pending, with claims 1, 8, and 16 in independent form. Claims 16, 19, and 20 are currently amended and claim 18 is canceled. Reconsideration is respectfully requested.
The Office Action sets forth the following:
1. Claim 16 stands rejected under 35 U.S.C. §102 as allegedly being anticipated by U.S. Patent No. 11,933,587 to Beblo.
2. Claims 16 and 17 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 102 as allegedly being anticipated by
3. Claims 18-20 are objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be
allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.

In accordance with 37 CFR 1.33(b), please make of record this summary of the December 14, 2024 interview between Examiner O'Hara and Applicants' representative John Carpenter. Applicant appreciates the opportunity to interview Examiner O'Hara regarding allowable subject matter. However, no agreement was reached during the interview. Allowable Subject Matter
Applicant notes with appreciation the Examiner's indication that claims 1-15 are allowed and acknowledging that claims 18-20 include allowable subject matter. Rejection of Claims under § 102

Independent claim 16 is rejected as allegedly anticipated by Beblo or Okamoto. Without comment on or conceding the merits of the rejections and in an effort to advance this case to allowance, claim 16 is amended to incorporate the features similar to those of allowable claim 18. Specifically, claim 16 has been amended to recite, in part, "a thrust device including an electric motor carried by the motor mount assembly." Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that independent claim 16, and all claims depending therefrom, are in condition for allowance for at least the reasons presented above and in view of the additional features of these claims.

In view of the foregoing, it is respectfully submitted that the claims are in condition for allowance, which allowance is respectfully requested. If any remaining issue could be expedited with a telephone call, it is requested that the Examiner telephone the undersigned in this regard. Although no fees are believed to be due at this time in addition to those submitted herewith, the Commissioner is hereby authorized and requested to charge any cost incurred in the filing of this paper to Deposit Account 501438 under Order No. 118630-00001.
